card.title: You Could at Least…
card.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Here's the bus timetable. I circled every bus I missed waiting for you to return my keys.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three circles. And here's the takeaway receipt from when my dinner was still hot.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll buy another dinner. Can we put the papers away?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep your money. Say you're sorry, and we can clear the table instead of reconstructing my evening.

mechanism: A documents the concrete cost of delayed keys until apologizing becomes simpler than continuing the reconstruction.
confusable: Unlike seeking financial compensation, A must use visible inconvenience to secure an apology.
comparison: D27-b refuses replacement dinner money in favor of clearing evidence after remorse; D27-a removes a sock after an apology.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
